summary: Iteration 3 smoke test: reviews (backend+UI), cosplay (backend+UI), and TTS backend all PASS. Regression on /anime/your-name is FIXED (no compile error). BLOCKER: TTS UI 'Hear voice' button (data-testid=speak-btn-N) is NOT implemented in Companion.jsx — assistant replies render as plain text bubbles with no speak button, despite Volume2 icon being imported.
passed: GET /api/reviews/suga-shrine returns list newest-first with 2+ existing reviews
POST /api/reviews (auth) creates new review, returns {ok:true, id:...}
POST /api/cosplay/generate returns valid PNG (base64, 2.4MB, ~12s) with correct PNG magic bytes
Reviews modal opens on click of location-reviews-btn-suga-shrine, shows existing reviews + review-form, and posted review appears
/cosplay page E2E: form renders (select+style buttons+notes+generate btn), clicking cosplay-generate-btn triggers /api/cosplay/generate and cosplay-result img renders with data:image/png;base64 src
Companion login+character select+send message works; assistant reply 'Greetings.' rendered

failed.issue: Companion.jsx does NOT render a 'Hear voice'/speak button on assistant message bubbles. No data-testid='speak-btn-N' exists in DOM. The Volume2 icon is imported but unused. Backend /api/companion/speak works fine; the UI hook is missing.
failed.evidence: Playwright wait_for_selector('[data-testid^="speak-btn-"]') timed out after 45s even though assistant reply 'Greetings.' was rendered. Grep of Companion.jsx shows no 'speak', 'speak-btn', or Volume2 usage inside the message rendering (lines 89-101). Screenshot .screenshots/comp_fail.png confirms bubble has no button.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Companion.jsx, add a 'Hear voice' button with data-testid={`speak-btn-${i}`} on each assistant message that calls POST /api/companion/speak with {text: m.text, character_id: active.id}, converts the response blob to an object URL, and plays it via new Audio(url).play(). The Volume2 icon is already imported.
